name: Ried im Zillertal
kurzbeschreibung: Charming village in the Zillertal with a pilgrimage church and traditional customs.
beschreibung:
Ried im Zillertal extends at an elevation of 630 meters in the Zillertal, Achensee and the Tuxer Alpen and is a quiet village community. The village has around 1,300 inhabitants and stretches over a spacious area with typical Tiroler farmhouses and agricultural businesses.

Hikers get their money's worth on numerous marked trails around the village, and culturally interested visitors discover historic buildings and traditional customs, while families appreciate the diverse range of leisure activities and child-friendly accommodations. In the summer months (from May to October), the surroundings transform into an outdoor paradise.

Ried im Zillertal is especially suitable for families and those seeking relaxation who want to combine tranquility with activities. The good transport connections and proximity to larger towns make the stay particularly pleasant.
